intro: Innkeeper Keldamyr manages the hearth and lodgings of the central inn in Dolanaar, Teldrassil. He offers food, drink, and a resting place for young night elves venturing forth from Shadowglen into the wider boughs of the World Tree.

p: Dolanaar is the primary village newcomers reach after departing the sheltered glade of Aldrassil. Innkeeper Keldamyr maintains the community's central haven, providing bread, spring water, and soft beds beneath the canopy of Teldrassil. Travelers, sentinels, and young novices bound for Darnassus frequently pause at his counter to rest their spirits, secure their hearthstones, and stock rations for the journey through the boughs.

Running an inn high within the branches requires steady supply lines from nearby settlements and tradesfolk. Local couriers often find themselves directed straight to Keldamyr's desk to drop off goods, linking him directly into the daily trade and logistics keeping the settlement of Dolanaar running smoothly.
